title: UAE's leading AI company G42 says its data center campus and overseas plans are on track despite regional tensions and Iranian attacks on UAE infrastructure (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: UAE's leading AI company G42 says its data center campus and overseas plans are on track despite regional tensions and Iranian attacks on UAE infrastructure — Despite attacks on regional infrastructure, G42 says its data center campus and overseas plans are on track. — Peng Xiao started the year riding high.
